merchant/30180-pk.htm.text: Trader Sara: Help! Somebody! Guards! Guards! Over here! A scoundrel! A murderer! A ruthless criminal! Help me! I shall be killed!

Q00652_AnAgedExAdventurer/30180-01.html.text: Sara: Thank you so much! My father-in-law came home safely, thanks to your help. You made him very happy, by the way! He hadn't met any fellow adventurers for quite a while. Please accept this as a token of my appreciation! Thank you again.

Q00652_AnAgedExAdventurer/30180-02.html.text: Sara: I'm so sorry. I thought you were just a customer... You're the one who helped my father-in-law!
